asks: Do you remember my name yet?
How many times is this now?
description: You know this person. You met them earlier, and it went fine, and you cannot produce a single detail of it. They are pleased to see you again and are waiting for you to catch up.
emotes: {it} raises an eyebrow as though you are running behind.
{it} nods along to something you have not said yet.
{it} checks the room, as if for the others.
looks: Their face is familiar in the way a word is familiar when you have said it forty times.
They are dressed exactly as they were the first time, which you also cannot remember.
They are waiting patiently for you to place them, and they are enjoying it a little.
name: somebody you have already met tonight
says: You said that before. It was funnier the first time.
Take your time. We have got all night, apparently.
